name: wowseru-ai-affiliate-storyboard
description: Create connected AI UGC affiliate storyboards and video prompts from product briefs, audience insights, and visual references.

interface.longDescription: Turn product information into a complete AI UGC affiliate production package: product and audience analysis, emotional storytelling, three connected six-panel 2×3 storyboards, three continuous video prompts, natural narration, character and product continuity locks, negative prompts, a story summary, and a production checklist. Supports user-requested languages and visual references. It does not generate or render the final images or videos.
defaultPrompt: Buat UGC review untuk produk affiliate saya.
Bantu analisis produk dan susun tiga scene video affiliate.
